title: We Chose: The Inspiration of Apollo
description: President John Kennedy’s challenge to land men on the Moon and return them safely to Earth in the 1960s was meant to encourage the United States to do what was hard, and to achieve what was considered by many to be impossible.  But the effect of that challenge, and of its realization, went even deeper: generations of men and women from around the world were inspired to commit to a lifetime of exploration, and the pursuit of the next giant leap. ___________________________ FOLLOW THE 50TH AT NASA/JSC  https://www.nasa.gov/specials/apollo50th/ https://twitter.com/NASA_Johnson https://www.facebook.com/NASAJSC/  HD Download: https://archive.org/details/jsc2019m000363_We_Chose_the_Inspiration_of_Apollo
keywords: nasa, apollo, apollo50th, houston, rice, jfk, john f kennedy
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
